messages:
sam (support): FYI — customer NovaHealth opened a ticket asking for streaming chat completions that emit structured fields as they become available + function/tool calls. They want per-field confidence scores and a way to pause/resume the stream for UI backpressure. Link: https://support.redwood.ai/CH-1427

deploy-bot: New support ticket #CH-1427 created and linked to this thread.

anna (product): Quick Q — are they on Dedicated or Hosted? Any existing workaround?

jordan (sales): They're on Dedicated. Onboarding scheduled next month; expected ARR ~ $80k. They said rollout depends on this working reliably. Timeline asked: ~6 weeks ideally.

mike (eng): From runtime POV, pause/resume + per-field confidences implies changes to streaming framing and the proto for partial structured payloads. Also need flow-control hooks. Rough guess: 3-4 sprints with 2 engineers for a full-featured impl.

priya (eng-ml): Structured outputs + per-field confidences will need new evals and dataset tagging. Function-calling + streaming partials interacts badly with KV cache and side-effecting tools — need clear atomicity semantics: can we emit a field before a dependent function returns?

sam (support): Customer said partial field emission is acceptable — e.g., send name/address early, then emit insurance_info after external lookup. They specifically asked for an ACK/credit-style backpressure so their UI can pause rendering while waiting on slow fields.

anna (product): Proposed acceptance criteria for an MVP: 1) stream partial structured JSON that can be incrementally parsed safely, 2) include an overall confidence score in each partial emission, 3) provide a simple API-level flow-control (pause/resume or ack batches), 4) documented fallback to non-streaming for full-atomic responses. Thoughts?

mike (eng): Agree with criteria. Note: function calls that trigger external requests should have a compatibility fallback — e.g., auto-switch to non-streaming call mode if the tool blocks. Need tracing/metrics for partial emissions and reassembly.

jordan (sales): Can we ship a smaller MVP faster: streaming text + structured hints, and compute confidences offline (post-processing)? That would buy time for per-field scores.

priya (eng-ml): Realistic MVP: streaming partial JSON + single overall confidence per emission. Per-field confidences in phase 2. That drops effort to ~1 sprint of focused work (plus evaluations).

anna (product): OK — plan: Phase 1 (MVP) = partial JSON streaming + overall confidence + basic flow-control API. Phase 2 = per-field confidences, richer flow-control (ACK semantics), and function-call atomicity improvements. Sam, can you confirm NovaHealth is ok with a phased delivery?

sam (support): Pinged them. They replied: phased is fine as long as phase 2 is tied to SLA for production. They want written confirmation before we finalize dates. :thumbsup:

anna (product): I'll create backlog item CH-1427-mvp with P1 for the Dedicated onboarding. Need eng sign-off in next planning meeting.

mike (eng): I'll open infra + runtime tickets and pair with Priya for eval pass. Tentative estimate for MVP: 1-2 engineers for 1 sprint.

anna (product): Thanks everyone — I'll update the ticket and add acceptance criteria + example payload in the ticket.

sam (support): Thanks — will keep customer updated and request SLA clause for phase 2.

(End of thread)
